issues.description: Template Main.java contains a commented usage example that instantiates Seal/Pig/Goat with two constructor arguments (name plus an extra "type/category" string), but the problem statement (UML/spec) defines only a single Animal attribute (name) and the solution implements constructors taking only `String name`. This can mislead students into adding an extra attribute/constructor parameter not required by the assignment.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Main.java example to use the one-argument constructors (`new Seal("Clarabelle")`, `new Pig("Doodle")`, `new Goat("Buttinsky")`). Alternatively, if a second attribute is truly intended, update the UML/problem statement and all animal classes/constructors consistently to include it.
